why: RJ-D36: selects a 100 x 50 rectangle at 10, 10, gives it a stroke, sets the width to 2 pt and the cap to round, dashes it with the dashed preset (scaled by the width), then exports SVG: the rect writes stroke-dasharray="8 4", stroke-linecap="round" and the miter join's stroke-miterlimit="10", and its bytes are checked.
